title: Deer eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='90' rx='40' ry='5' fill='#3a5a40'/>
  <!-- deer body -->
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='66' rx='20' ry='13' fill='#c98a4b'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='38' y='74' width='5' height='15' rx='2' fill='#a86b32'/>
  <rect x='48' y='76' width='5' height='13' rx='2' fill='#b5773a'/>
  <rect x='60' y='76' width='5' height='13' rx='2' fill='#b5773a'/>
  <rect x='68' y='74' width='5' height='15' rx='2' fill='#a86b32'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M40 60 L34 38 L44 36 L50 58 Z' fill='#c98a4b'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='34' rx='11' ry='9' fill='#d99a5b'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='25' rx='3' ry='6' fill='#c98a4b' transform='rotate(-25 26 25)'/>
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='25' rx='3' ry='6' fill='#c98a4b' transform='rotate(25 46 25)'/>
  <!-- antlers -->
  <path d='M32 26 L28 12 M28 12 L24 14 M28 12 L30 8' stroke='#e8b06a' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M40 26 L44 12 M44 12 L48 14 M44 12 L42 8' stroke='#e8b06a' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='32' r='2' fill='#2b1a0e'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='39' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#e8b06a'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='38' r='1.5' fill='#6b3f1d'/>
  <!-- snack: apple being eaten -->
  <circle cx='18' cy='42' r='6' fill='#e63946'/>
  <path d='M24 42 L28 40' stroke='#4f9d69' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- bite mark / mouth open -->
  <path d='M20 40 Q22 42 20 44' stroke='#6b3f1d' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='60' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#f0e0c0'/>
</svg>
